name: Same-Day Crowns
teaser: Get a custom, permanent crown in a single visit — no temporaries, no second appointment.
overview: At Pleitez Dental Corp, we offer same-day crown technology so you can walk in with a damaged tooth and walk out with a permanent, natural-looking crown — all in one appointment. No impressions sent to an off-site lab, no waiting weeks with a temporary crown.

Same-day crowns are custom-milled to precisely fit your tooth using advanced digital scanning technology. The result is a crown that looks, feels, and functions just like your natural tooth — completed on your schedule.

whatToExpect.title: Examination & Digital Scan
whatToExpect.body: We examine the tooth, take a digital impression, and design your custom crown digitally — no messy traditional molds required.

whatToExpect.title: Crown Milling
whatToExpect.body: Your crown is precision-milled from a solid ceramic block right here in the office, matched to the shade and shape of your natural teeth.

whatToExpect.title: Placement & Polish
whatToExpect.body: We place and bond your permanent crown — adjusting the fit until it's perfect. You leave with a complete, lasting restoration the same day.

faqs.question: Are same-day crowns as good as traditional crowns?
faqs.answer: Yes — same-day ceramic crowns are durable, natural-looking, and long-lasting. They are made from the same high-quality porcelain as lab-fabricated crowns, with the added benefit of being completed in a single visit.

faqs.question: How long does a same-day crown appointment take?
faqs.answer: Most same-day crown appointments take approximately 1.5 to 2 hours from start to finish, including the examination, digital scan, milling, and placement.

faqs.question: Will my crown look natural?
faqs.answer: Absolutely. The crown is color-matched to your surrounding teeth so it blends in seamlessly. Most people won't even know you have a crown.

faqs.question: Is the procedure painful?
faqs.answer: No. Local anesthesia is used throughout the procedure so you stay comfortable. Any sensitivity after the appointment is mild and temporary.
